name: Xuzhou

queries.query: 徐州市 不动产登记 地籍图 查询 徐州市自然资源和规划局 官方
queries.scope: Find local registry services and an anonymous full parcel geometry service.
queries.result: The Xuzhou government service portal lists city-level real-estate registration workflows under the Xuzhou Natural Resources and Planning Bureau. A 2025 city report says registration, trade and tax services are handled online. No anonymous city parcel-vector viewer or downloadable full geometries were found in the reviewed sources.
queries.executionMethod: Separate Chinese-language search and first-party government service page/report inspection; no person- or property-specific record query.

queries.executionMethod: Separate English-language search and first-party municipal service-page inspection.
